scope: Items, materials, facilities and recipe/content-entity coverage only. Creature/ecology coverage remains SGC-04B and vehicle/module/media-resource coverage remains SGC-04C.

evidence.specific_scope: The routed location-aware-inventory requirement decomposes to the existing Inventory/Asset owner. PPIA-03 preserves separate Asset Definition, Asset Instance, ownership, custody, control, access, possession/location, containment, equipment, quantity, mutable state and history concepts; completed MIB-14 explicitly preserves D17 as sole live Asset/inventory/state authority and adds storage/workstation seams without a second inventory ledger.

records.owner: Governed Item content registry / D17-facing Item Definitions

evidence.specific_scope: The current governed structured Item surface is represented by nine direct Item-domain datasets totaling 5,389 rows, plus mixed-domain material/facility adjuncts that may not be counted wholesale as personal Items. These are governed content definitions feeding the Item/Asset experience; this row makes no claim that every catalog row is a live Asset Instance or runtime mechanic.
Completed DPL-06 preserves D17 as tools/equipment and extracted material/Asset truth, with raw extraction ending at a D17 material-output handoff and no parallel material ledger.

MIB-12 is completed_verified and implements deterministic crafting requirements, reservation, owner-version binding, D17 consumption/output commit, recovery and repair/upgrade/modify seams while preserving D17 Asset/inventory authority.

MIB-14 is completed_verified and provides module/facility compatibility, cargo/capacity/loadout validation and base storage/facility/workstation integration while retaining D17 live inventory/state truth and avoiding duplicate facility/inventory ledgers.

ICF is completed_verified through ICF-15. The final compiled projection covers ingredient, preparation, recipe and creature-harvest foundations with 971 primary ingredient definitions, 400 derived preparations and 319 recipe/template records; live Asset state remains D17-owned. SGC-04A claims only ingredient/preparation/recipe coverage here; creature-harvest gaps remain for SGC-04B.

LSS is completed_verified through LSS-10 and supplies governed loot/scavenge/salvage content, search/workbench and golden proof while preserving D17 Asset/inventory, MIB-12 crafting/repair, MIB-14 compatibility/storage/workshops and ICF-07 biological-harvest boundaries.

evidence.unresolved_question: Should the two retained published Taser source contexts remain explicit variants/conflicting definitions, or is there authoritative source/owner evidence that resolves them to one governed identity?
evidence.source_gap_or_conflict: PPIA-03 records two published source contexts and prohibits automatic identity merge; no later bounded SGC-04A evidence was found that resolves the identity conflict. Numerical balance remains outside this source-identity decision.

evidence.unresolved_question: For the seven retained energy-weapon capacity fields with unspecified source values, should canonical content remain explicit-unknown or should a governed authored/source-recovery decision supply capacities?
evidence.source_gap_or_conflict: PPIA-03 explicitly prohibits inventing capacities merely to complete reload/charge UI; unknown maximum/current must remain distinct from zero, unlimited and not-applicable. No authoritative values were found in the bounded SGC-04A owner review.

evidence.unresolved_question: Should Energy Sniper Rifle, Plasma Carbine and Cryo Blaster remain reference-only names, or should an owner-authorized content/source-recovery action create governed Item Definitions?
evidence.source_gap_or_conflict: PPIA-03 records these three names as ammo-reference-only and prohibits creating damage/range/weight/cost from the name alone. No governed definitions were found in the bounded SGC-04A review.

partition_closure.sgc_04c_remaining_partition: Vehicle/module-specific location/compatibility semantics remain reserved for SGC-04C.

boundaries: No content row becomes a live Asset Instance merely because it exists in a governed catalog.
Location-aware inventory remains a multi-owner composition and is not collapsed to one synthetic owner.
Materials remain D17 Asset/material truth; DPL extraction and MIB-12 transformations hand off rather than duplicate material state.
ICF recipe/ingredient definitions do not create a second inventory ledger or autonomous Project/Cozy authority.
Creature harvesting/ecology remains SGC-04B; vehicle/module/media-resource routing remains SGC-04C.
The Taser conflict, unspecified energy-weapon capacities and reference-only weapon names remain visible SGC-07A decisions rather than fabricated content.
